inventory.title: SourceSteward bounded native Git/jj inventory (schema 1)
inventory.description: Sampled local facts, qualified unknown observations and operational failures. Native jj disk freshness is unknown without snapshots. Added properties and diagnostic codes are compatible extensions. Usage/writer failures may not emit complete JSON.

inventory_git_identity.title: SourceSteward inspection result (schema 1)
inventory_git_identity.description: Success and operational failure results. Usage and writer failures may not emit JSON. Unknown object properties and diagnostic codes are compatible extensions.

input_path.description: Absolute path when available; empty if input cannot be represented or resolved.

inventory_jj_identity.title: SourceSteward native jj inspection result (schema 2)
inventory_jj_identity.description: Native jj stored identity and operational failures. Git/version retain schema 1. Additional object properties and diagnostic codes are compatible extensions. Usage/writer failures may not emit complete JSON.

input_path.description: Absolute path when available; empty if input cannot be represented or resolved.
